dm: Which managerial tasks make up P-O-L-I-C-D?
Planning, Organising, Leading, Implementing, Controlling, De-briefing
Planning, Operating, Listening, Innovating, Costing, Designing
Positioning, Organising, Leading, Investing, Controlling, Delivering
Planning, Outsourcing, Launching, Iterating, Coaching, Documenting
P-O-L-I-C-D = Planning, Organising, Leading, Implementing, Controlling and De-briefing.
Who defined core competency, and what are its three tests?
Prahalad & Hamel — hard to imitate, reusable across markets, adds end-customer value
C.K. Prahalad & Gary Hamel: hard to IMITATE, REUSABLE, adds END-CUSTOMER value.
Mission ∩ Vision = PURPOSE — the reason to exist beyond profit.
Which is TRUE of strategy versus tactics?
Strategy is short term and easy to copy
Tactics are the WHY; strategy is the HOW
Strategy is large-scale, long-term and difficult to copy
Strategy = planning/WHY, long term, hard to copy. Tactics = doing/HOW, short term, easy to copy.
Step 5 of the 9 steps to plan a design strategy is…
Step 5: future scenarios by PREDICTIVE ANALYTICS. Step 3 is the internal audit, step 9 the de-brief.
Blue Ocean strategy (Kim & Mauborgne, 2005) aims to…
Beat competition in an existing market
Make competition irrelevant by creating uncontested market space
Blue Ocean creates uncontested markets and new demand; focus is VALUE INNOVATION (e.g., Airbnb).
In the PLC, which stage has high cost and negative cash flow?
Introduction = high cost, NEGATIVE cash flow; profit peaks before sales (lag).
Which Gartner analytics type answers 'How to make it happen?'
Prescriptive (foresight) gives rules and recommendations — the most valuable type.
In the six levels of a brand, the meta meaning of Mercedes-Benz is…
Attribute → benefits → culture → personality → profile → META MEANING: SUCCESS.
Levitt's distinction: creativity is ___, innovation is ___.
Doing new things / thinking up new things
Thinking up new things / doing new things
Creativity = THINKING up new things; innovation = DOING new things.
Why is jugaad NOT counted as innovation?
It is a frugal one-off fix with no planned end offering
Jugaad is a starting point — a one-off fix with no planned offering, may fail scrutiny.
In India, which Act protects the appearance (not function) of a product?
Design registration protects form and appearance only — Designs Act 2000.
The term of an Indian patent is…
Patent term is 20 years, granted for full disclosure.
Which Creative Commons licence is the MOST open?
Most → least open: BY, BY-SA, BY-ND, BY-NC, BY-NC-SA, BY-NC-ND.
sd: Service design, by definition, plans and organises…
Logos, colours and fonts of a service
People, infrastructure and processes so the experience is coherent and the business efficient
SD organises PEOPLE, INFRASTRUCTURE and PROCESSES — coherent for the customer, efficient for the business.
What do the letters IHIP stand for?
Intangible · simultaneous production & consumption · Heterogeneous · Perishable (empty train seat).
An empty train seat that is lost once the train leaves shows which characteristic?
Perishable — unused capacity can't be stored.
Who introduced the service blueprint, and when?
Lynn Shostack's 1982 HBR article 'How to Design a Service'.
In a service blueprint, the line of VISIBILITY separates…
Line of interaction: customer | frontstage. Line of visibility: frontstage | backstage. Line of internal interaction: backstage | support.
Satisfaction when experience EXCEEDS expectation is…
Match → satisfied; less → dissatisfied; more → DELIGHTED.
Which of the five SD principles means making the intangible visible?
System ANALYSIS is about ___, system DESIGN is about ___.
What it should do / how parts are implemented
A system fully determined by its inputs, like a calculator, is…
Which information system gives 'what if' decision support?
DSS = decision support system. TPS records, MIS reports, EIS serves executives.
In a user story map, the ACTIVITIES row is called the…
Activities = backbone; tasks = walking skeleton; stories sliced into releases.
Which nesting from outer to inner is correct?
sus: Energy classified as CONVENTIONAL vs NON-CONVENTIONAL is split around which event?
Conventional = in use before/around 1973; non-conventional came after the oil crisis.
Electricity, thermal energy and hydrogen are examples of…
Thermal (coal + gas) share of India's electricity basket in the notes is about…
Approximate voltage of one silicon solar cell is…
Each PN-junction cell gives ~0.5–0.6 V DC.
Mono-crystalline cells compared with poly cells are…
MONO: single crystal, black, rounded corners, more efficient. POLY: blue, square, cheaper.
Wind turbine power in the maximum-power region varies as…
The change of wind speed with height is called…
Earth-air tunnels (4 × 70 m) are a feature of which building?
RETREAT, Gurgaon (composite climate) — earth-air tunnels, solar chimneys, absorption chillers.
What does the HIMURJA vs HP Co-op Bank comparison show?
Designed-in sustainability costs less (+5.6%) than retrofit (+18.6%)
Cold climates can't use passive solar
More good — circular, waste = food, upcycling
Eco-effectiveness (C2C) is positively beneficial; eco-efficiency only slows a linear system.
A leased washing machine that is returned and remanufactured belongs to the…
Technical cycle — return & disassembly → technical nutrients.
The Fibonacci solar tree is inspired by…
Phyllotaxis (~137°) reduces self-shading. Sunflower → trackers; leaf veins → fractal cell.
'Waste equals food' and 'use current solar income' are principles of…
ve: Which photoreceptors handle colour and fine detail in bright light?
Cones, concentrated at the fovea. Rods: dim light, periphery.
The eye's dark focus resting point is about…
Use AUDITORY rather than visual display when the message is…
Simple, short and needs immediate action
Sound for short, urgent, time-based messages, or when the person is moving.
Clockwise = increase is an example of which compatibility?
Movement compatibility. Knobs below displays = spatial.
For exit signs, Collins & Lerner (1983) found…
Recommended stroke width:height for white text on black is…
White on black 1:8–1:10 because of irradiation; black on white 1:6–1:8.
Why is lowercase easier to read than ALL CAPS?
Ascenders and descenders give a word shape (envelope)
Cap height should be at least what fraction of reading distance?
How many surface colours can be used reliably as a code?
Surface colours 9; colour of lights 3; shapes 5.
Why should colour coding always be redundant with text or shape?
Redundancy protects colour-blind users and low-light viewing.
Which sign in the Netherlands road study added DANGER meaning without losing SPEED meaning?
Beck's 1933 London Underground map is an example of…
Maps suppress truth to show what matters (Monmonier).
For drug labels (Quinn et al.), what should be the LARGEST element?
Brand name largest; generic slightly smaller; strength near the name.
